    • powSign

      default org.ngengine.platform.AsyncTask<SignedNostrEvent> powSign(UnsignedNostrEvent event, int difficulty)
      Sign an event and attach a proof of computational work to it. Make sure to limit the maxium difficulty passed to this method, as it doesn't do any validation on the difficulty parameter, it might run forever if the difficulty is too high.
      Parameters:
      event - the event to sign
      difficulty - the target difficulty for the proof of work
      Returns:
      an async task that will be completed with the signed event containing the proof of work
